description: Get the full taxonomic record for a species by its ITIS TSN (Taxonomic Serial Number): accepted scientific name, author, kingdom, taxonomic rank, parent taxon, validity/usage status, known synonyms, and common names in multiple languages (itis.gov, USGS public data)

tsn.description: Taxonomic Serial Number (TSN) — ITIS's unique numeric identifier for a taxon, e.g. "180543" for Ursus arctos. Obtain a TSN from itistaxonomy.search_scientific_name or itistaxonomy.search_common_name.

name: science.itistaxonomy.full_record

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Full Taxonomic Record
